name: Aino Nieminen
bio:
Aino's fascination with motorsport began as a child, captivated by the intricate technology powering Formula 1 cars. This passion led her to pursue a degree in electrical engineering, specializing in embedded systems and data acquisition. Her career started at a small rally team, where she honed her skills troubleshooting complex electronic issues in demanding environments.

She joined Eurofarma RC three years ago and quickly became an indispensable member of the team. Aino possesses a knack for identifying subtle electronic inefficiencies and developing innovative solutions to improve performance. Her colleagues appreciate her calm demeanor under pressure and her unwavering commitment to excellence. Aino's ability to bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application makes her a valuable asset to the team's engineering efforts.

Aino is driven by a relentless pursuit of optimization. She believes that even the smallest electronic refinements can translate into significant gains on the track. Her dedication to precision and her proactive approach to problem-solving set her apart, making her a rising star in the world of motorsport electronics.
